---
title: "All Posts"
listing:
  - id: all-posts
    contents:
      # Match only directories starting with a year digit (all blog posts are
      # named YYYY-MM-DD-slug/ or YYYY/MM/DD/slug/). This avoids accidentally
      # picking up blog/index.qmd or other non-post pages in this directory.
      - "../2*/**/index.qmd"
      - "../2*/**/index.ipynb"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    fields: [title, date, description]
    feed: true
    page-size: 1000
---

::: {#all-posts}
:::
